fields.title: Model / dataset / space / creator record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Hugging Face's own official API JSON shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "models"/"model-detail" records carry the full upstream model object verbatim (id, tags, pipeline_tag, siblings file list, cardData, config). "datasets"/"dataset-detail" and "spaces"/"space-detail" are analogous. "creator" records carry the upstream user or organization overview object verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search query, repo ID, or username that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-api, S1-api-user, S1-api-organization, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. model_not_found, dataset_not_found, space_not_found, creator_not_found, invalid_request).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: ID
id.description: Upstream repo ID in "namespace/name" form (models/datasets/spaces modes).

author.title: Author
author.description: Username or organization that owns this repo.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: List of tag strings (license, library, language, task, etc.).

pipeline_tag.title: Pipeline tag
pipeline_tag.description: Models mode -- the primary task this model is tagged for.

library_name.title: Library
library_name.description: Models mode -- e.g. transformers, diffusers, sentence-transformers.

siblings.title: Files
siblings.description: Model-detail/dataset-detail/space-detail mode -- full list of files in the repo, passed through as-is.

cardData.title: Card metadata
cardData.description: Structured front-matter from the repo's README/model card, passed through as-is.

sdk.title: SDK
sdk.description: Spaces mode -- gradio / streamlit / docker / static.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across model / dataset / space / creator records.
